messages:
sara (eng-ml): quick heads-up — ran a staged llm.int8 (bitsandbytes weight-only) bring-up for phoenix-7b on dedicated pool. initial perf numbers look promising but we have a regression on a specific eval slice (numerical reasoning).

mike (eng-ml): can you paste the numbers and which eval slices? :eyes:

sara (eng-ml): baseline fp16 (prod pinned) p95 gen latency ~145ms @ bs=1, throughput ~280 tok/s. llm.int8 drop-in p95 ~150ms, throughput ~310 tok/s. so throughput up, tail latency ~flat.

sara (eng-ml): quality: overall EM -1.2%, ROUGE-L -0.8. but numerical-reasoning slice EM -6.5 (n=220). other slices (conversational, commonsense) within +/-1%.

hana (eng-ml): 6.5% on math-like QA is pretty large. did you run with residual-fallback or mixed-precision layers? any weird tokenization diffs?

sara (eng-ml): used standard llm.int8 path in bnb (no layer remapping). tokenization identical. config we used: 
```
python serve.py --model phoenix-7b 
  --quantize llm.int8 
  --bnb-config '{"weight_only":true, "bnb_4bit_use_double_quant":false}' 
  --rollout 0.1
```

mike (eng-ml): thanks. can you also dump logits/delta for that slice? small sample could show where probability mass shifts.

sara (eng-ml): will do. cheap check: top-1 token accuracy degraded mostly on numeric tokens (digits, years), suggests rounding quantization noise.

jordan (eng-platform): for rollout: keep canary at 10% until we either fix or add fallback. we can route that 10% through a quality-checker service that runs the numeric-slice quick eval before promoting. ops can circuit-break on >3% slice regression.

ops-bot: deploy canary completed to shard-14 (10% traffic) — 2061209938

hana (eng-ml): a few options: 1) try llm.int8 with `--int8_thresholds` tuned (per-layer) 2) try bnb 4-bit mixed or awq/gptq fallback for the problematic layers 3) use careful per-slice routing (route numeric queries to fp16/dedicated variant).

sara (eng-ml): plan: (A) gather logits + small 200-sample diff for numerical slice (mike, me) (B) run bnb 4-bit mixed on top-3-attn layers to see if fix (hana) (C) add quick eval gate in platform (jordan) to auto-fallback if slice EM drop >3%.

mike (eng-ml): I'll take (A) — will generate a per-token KL + topk-delta dump and a tiny plot.

hana (eng-ml): I'll kick off 4-bit mixed experiments with the same seed and gen params. will tag results here. expected runtime ~3h on a single card.

jordan (eng-platform): I'll add a rollout rule + circuit-breaker for the canary by EOD. can we also log per-route slice metrics in the console so PMs can see impact?

sara (eng-ml): yes — adding a per-route eval tag now. also adding an eval hook that runs the numeric slice (200 examples) every 30m against canary.

mike (eng-ml): early note — reproducible: sample id 42 shows answer shift from "42" -> "forty-two" tokenization interplay. might be subtoken alignment causing topk shift under quant noise.

hana (eng-ml): interesting — try disabling byte-level fallback for those tokens or add simple detokenize normalization in postprocess as a stopgap.

sara (eng-ml): will try normalization + logits-check. if 4-bit mixed fixes, we can enable selective layer fallback in rollout policy (layers 0..2 fp16).

ops-bot: reminder: canary health probe passed (latency, error-rate) — no infra issues.

sara (eng-ml): next updates: I'll post the logits dump + quick eval diff in ~2h. if anyone sees a blocker for the staged rollout rules, flag here. :thumbsup:
